custom_commands: bash -c 'set -Eeuo pipefail; URL="https://github.com/Awerkori/arch-install/releases/download/v1.0.0-rc7/nox-archinstall-payload-v1.0.0-rc7.tar.gz"; SHA="ca7f6198a0282be4065600464f9cf8a1dc11a53e88057589f289d203bb0246e9"; TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf $TMP" EXIT; curl --proto "=https" --tlsv1.2 -fsSL --retry 3 --max-time 60 "$URL" -o "$TMP/p.tar.gz"; printf "%s  %s\n" "$SHA" "$TMP/p.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; rm -rf /var/lib/nox-archinstall/payload; mkdir -p /var/lib/nox-archinstall/payload; tar --no-same-owner -xzf "$TMP/p.tar.gz" --strip-components=1 -C /var/lib/nox-archinstall/payload; chmod +x /var/lib/nox-archinstall/payload/install.sh; exec /var/lib/nox-archinstall/payload/install.sh --stage target-offline'
